scientific_integrity: The all-time analytical argument reduces to an exact finite 1022-cut lemma. The packaged standard-library Python code exhausts this finite lemma using integer arithmetic and confirms the full 32-orbit partition. The continuous-time extension is proved by spectral decomposition and convex interpolation, not by numerical sampling; independent audit is not performed. The initial public date is the 2013 arXiv v1 submission of the lead source.
scientific_limitations: Ten-vertex unweighted Petersen graph and its unit-rate continuous-time Markov semigroup only; real signals and unweighted complete-pair Gini variation. No classification of other strongly regular graphs, weighted rates, or all multilevel extremizers. Historical priority may be limited by unindexed publications or full texts unavailable for comparison.
title: Sharp complete-pair Gini heat contraction on the Petersen graph
